required_live_and_scanner_gates.failure_rule: Any preimage, occurrence, build, review, scanner, replay, or inventory defect aborts the mapping/issue append.

conditional_mapping_decision.rationale: Stacks proves the canonical Gamma(X,Z_A)-module structure on global Ext and the Z_A-module structure on sheaf Ext for left modules over an arbitrary ring sheaf, and recovers Z(Gamma(X,A)) only under equality with Gamma(X,Z_A). The p.188 diplomatic wording is preserved as a recorded source error; corrected French and English replace the false larger scalar ring. No larger-center action is asserted in general.
conditional_mapping_decision.id_allocation_rule: Only the final successor builder may replace @D1029_MAPPING_DECISION_ID@, after r70 and every earlier authorized decision are sealed. It must allocate exactly the next contiguous mapping decision ID from the actual final predecessor. This design intentionally does not reserve D001052 or any other D-number.

exact_new_issue.append_timing: Append only in the final successful mapping transaction. During source and live production the defect is logically open but no provisional issue row is written; the appended final row is resolved because all gates have already passed.

sequential_transaction_requirements.requirement: Complete and freeze the no-overwrite p.188 source repair. Verify its admission, two source-ledger appends, reader outputs, QA, semantic successor, exact single-ID occurrences, and byte preservation. No mapping-dossier append occurs at this stage.
Complete the single live candidate insertion, build, deterministic page QA, independent post-live review, and byte-identical scanner oracle/replay. Freeze every evidence identity.

After r70 and all earlier authorized mapping decisions are sealed, select the actual immediate mapping predecessor. Require its receipt PASS, contiguous decision and issue sequences, the bound D000539 history row, and a target map row byte-identical to r69 physical line 825 except for changes explicitly and independently authorized before D1029. Any overlap on the target unit requires a new design.

Allocate the next contiguous mapping decision ID from that actual predecessor and substitute it identically into conditional_mapping_decision.decision_id, exact_new_issue.row.resolution_decision, and exact_map_replacement.replacement_values.decision_id. Do not use a D-number reserved by or present in r70.

Require the actual predecessor issue tail to be I000032 and I000033 to occur zero times. Serialize exactly one I000033 row using the r69 issue schema. Preserve I000032 and every predecessor issue byte.

Serialize exactly one mapping decision row using the r69 decision schema, append it after the actual predecessor decision bytes, replace exactly the named map row, and project all other mapping payload files byte-identically except scanner-derived outputs and the successor status/receipt.

Preflight a no-overwrite successor contract that binds the actual predecessor receipt and full inventory, this design, the frozen source-repair audit and source chain, live/build/review evidence, and scanner oracle/replay. It must compute all projected bytes and reject any collision, drift, unexpected append, or extra changed map row.

Execute through an exclusive staging directory and atomic directory rename only after preflight PASS, then independently replay the builder/contract against the promoted bytes and verify the complete inventory and receipt. On any failure, append nothing or roll back the unverified successor without touching the predecessor.
